title: Not All Variables Agree: Reliability-Aware Variable-Wise Gradient Surgery for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.08554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In data-driven training, multivariate time-series forecasting is usually optimized with a scalar loss averaged over samples, variables, and horizons. This averaging is convenient, but the optimizer sees only the aggregated gradient, which does not reveal whether the variable-wise contributions align or oppose one another. To quantify how often this disagreement arises, we measure the variable-wise gradients directly and find that 30.6% of their pairwise cosine similarities are negative on average across seven datasets. However, conflict and harm are not the same thing. Under shared training 35 of the 64 variables do worse than a full-input single-target oracle, and the harmed fraction is not reliably predicted by how often gradients conflict. We propose Per-Variable Surgery (PV-Surgery), an optimizer-side training strategy for backbones with cache-compatible layers. One backward pass builds variable-wise gradient proxies from output-side

translated_title: 并非所有变量都一致：面向多变量时间序列预测的可靠性感知的变量级梯度手术
translated_abstract: 在数据驱动的训练中，多变量时间序列预测通常使用在样本、变量和预测时域上取平均的标量损失进行优化。这种平均化虽然方便，但优化器只能看到聚合后的梯度，无法揭示各变量的贡献是相互一致还是相互冲突。为了量化这种分歧出现的频率，我们直接测量了变量级梯度，发现在七个数据集上平均有30.6%的两两余弦相似度为负值。然而，梯度冲突与性能损害并不是一回事。在共享训练下，64个变量中有35个变量的表现劣于全输入单目标oracle，且受损变量的比例并不能通过梯度冲突的频率来可靠预测。我们提出了Per-Variable Surgery（PV-Surgery），这是一种面向具有缓存兼容层的骨干网络的优化器侧训练策略。仅需一次反向传播，即可从输出侧构建变量级梯度代理。
tldr: 该论文通过直接测量变量级梯度揭示了多变量时间序列预测中梯度冲突与性能损害并不等同的现象，并提出了一种优化器侧的变量级梯度手术训练策略PV-Surgery，以提升共享训练下各变量的预测可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that gradient conflicts and performance harm are not equivalent in multivariate time-series forecasting by directly measuring variable-wise gradients, and proposes PV-Surgery, an optimizer-side variable-wise gradient surgery training strategy to improve per-variable reliability under shared training.
